metadata.Name: FREDSum
metadata.Description: A dataset of French political debates for the purpose of enhancing resources for multi-lingual dialogue summarization.
metadata.Paper Title: FREDSum: A Dialogue Summarization Corpus for French Political Debates
metadata.Venue Name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
metadata.Abstract: Recent advances in deep learning have improved abstractive summarization systems. This paper presents FREDSum, a dataset of French political debates for multi-lingual dialogue summarization. The dataset consists of manually transcribed and annotated debates covering various topics and perspectives. The importance of high-quality transcription and annotations for training accurate dialogue summarization models is highlighted. Baseline experiments using state-of-the-art methods are provided, and further research is encouraged to advance the field.
